purpose: Input specification for generating fictional enterprise fixture records with NeMo Data Designer or an equivalent structured-data workflow.
prohibitions: Do not use names, messages, queries, documents, identifiers, or tool payloads from Personal Assistant or any real enterprise system.
Do not generate agent traces, tool-call trajectories, ATOF, ATIF, answers, or evaluator judgments.

constraints: Every participant must reference a generated person email.
Some threads are relevant noise, not every lexical match is authoritative.
Search results expose metadata only; facts live in message bodies.
Include both current and stale discussion of a shared topic.
Every attendee must reference a generated person email.
Policy material must be distinguishable from current operational status.
Every owner must reference a generated person email.
Discovery exposes only metadata; content is read through bounded JSON Pointer paths.
Every owner must reference a generated person email.

required_world_facts: A configured first-call transient error has an authoritative recovery path
